en_title: NieR Creator Yoko Taro Says He Would Retire From Making Video Games but Fear of Dementia Keeps Him Working
cn_title: 《尼尔》主创横尾太郎称怕失智而不退休
subtitle: 不想再工作了
opus_summary: 《尼尔》系列创作者横尾太郎表示，自己早已实现人生目标，如今仍在工作只是因为担心没有收入。他曾考虑退休，却因害怕患上失智症而继续创作；对于日本游戏业的未来，他认为AI等技术让年轻创作者拥有更多机会。

paragraphs.en: NieR franchise creator Yoko Taro dropped a big revelation about his motivations for continuing to work and his thoughts on the future of Japan’s game industry. As reported by Denfaminicogamer , Taro was asked if he had any current projects or plans to make a new game. He replied “nothing really,” and confessed that “I’m done with working. I don’t want to do it anymore.”
paragraphs.cn: 《尼尔》系列创作者横尾太郎近日透露了自己继续工作的动力，以及对日本游戏产业未来的看法。据Denfaminicogamer报道，有人问横尾太郎目前是否正在参与什么项目，或是否计划制作新游戏。他回答「基本没有」，并坦言：「我已经不想工作了。我不想再干下去了。」

paragraphs.en: On top of this, Taro revealed that he already achieved his life goal before he even made critically-acclaimed titles like NieR Automata. Taro's first game as director was 2003 PS2 title Drakengard (known as Drag-on Dragoon in Japan). “With Drakengard, the first game I was given the opportunity to direct, I was actually able to do almost everything the way I wanted,” he said, noting that he was able to release a game that “represented the best I could do at the time.”
paragraphs.cn: 此外，横尾太郎还透露，在制作《尼尔：机械纪元》等广受好评的作品之前，他就已经实现了自己的人生目标。横尾太郎担任导演的第一款游戏，是2003年登陆PS2的《龙背上的骑兵》（日本称为《Drag-on Dragoon》）。他说：「《龙背上的骑兵》是我第一次获得导演机会的作品，我实际上几乎完全按照自己的想法完成了它。」他还表示，自己当时推出了一款「代表了那时我所能做到的最佳水平」的游戏。

paragraphs.en: “As a game otaku, I think the dream is to release something you’ve always wanted to create into the world. Having achieved that dream, I view everything after that as the remainder of my life,” he continued. Taro went on to reveal that he merely continued working because he’d be in trouble if he had no income.
paragraphs.cn: 他继续说道：「作为一名游戏宅，我认为所谓梦想，就是把自己一直想创作的东西带到这个世界上。既然已经实现了这个梦想，我会把那之后的一切都视为人生剩余的部分。」横尾太郎随后透露，他之所以继续工作，只是因为没有收入就会陷入麻烦。

paragraphs.en: Recently, he has considered retiring as he believes his savings and pension would be enough. However, he has a fear of developing dementia in old age, noting that he has heard of people being diagnosed with the disorder after retiring, and it is this fear that motivates him to keep working. So when he faces a difficult situation at work, he gets through it by telling himself: “This is good for preventing dementia.”
paragraphs.cn: 最近，横尾太郎开始考虑退休，因为他认为自己的积蓄和养老金应该足以支撑生活。不过，他担心自己年老后患上失智症。他听说过有人退休后被诊断出这种疾病，而正是这份恐惧促使他继续工作。因此，当他在工作中遇到困难时，便会这样告诉自己：「这有助于预防失智症。」

paragraphs.en: Taro made these revelations during a talk session with Ender Lilies and Ender Magnolia director Keisuke Okabe at The Tenth Mosaic video game culture festival held at the Tokyo French Institute last month. Of course, Taro is well-known for making eccentric and sometimes deadpan statements from under his ubiquitous Emil mask, so what he said should perhaps be taken with a grain of salt.
paragraphs.cn: 上个月，横尾太郎在东京法语学院举办的第十届Mosaic电子游戏文化节上，与《终结的百合花》和《终焉的玛格诺利亚》导演岡部啓一共同参加座谈，并在活动期间透露了这些想法。当然，横尾太郎经常戴着标志性的艾米尔面具发表古怪、有时甚至一本正经的言论，因此，他这次的说法或许也不宜全盘当真。

paragraphs.en: Regarding the future of the Japanese games industry, Taro quipped: “I’m going to die soon, so I really don’t care what happens to Japan’s game industry. However, I think that recently AI and various technologies have created a breeding ground where creators in their teens and 20s, who are even younger than Mr. Okabe, can freely create things.”
paragraphs.cn: 谈到日本游戏产业的未来时，横尾太郎调侃道：「我很快就要死了，所以日本游戏产业以后会怎样，我真的不在乎。不过，我认为近来AI和各种技术已经创造出了一片适合创作的土壤，让那些年龄比岡部先生还小、十几岁和二十多岁的创作者能够自由地制作作品。」

paragraphs.en: “I’m 56 now, but when people my age were young, we only had two options if we wanted to make a game: either ‘join a game company’ or ‘make a niche game for PC.’ If you wanted to make a 3D game you had no choice but to join a game company.” Taro said that the options for people who want to make games have broadened considerably since then, but this is inevitably leading to tougher competition.
paragraphs.cn: 「我现在56岁了，但我们这一代人年轻时，想做游戏只有两条路：加入游戏公司，或者为PC制作小众游戏。如果想做3D游戏，就只能加入游戏公司。」横尾太郎表示，如今想做游戏的人已经有了多得多的选择，但这也不可避免地让竞争更加激烈。

paragraphs.en: “I think this competition will gradually spread like fire from the younger generations to the older generations of developers,” he commented. “As I’m already on the older side, I’m simply filled with fear and trepidation, hoping that these flames don’t reach me before I die.”
paragraphs.cn: 他评论道：「我觉得，这种竞争会像火一样，逐渐从年轻一代开发者蔓延到年长一代。我已经算是年纪大的了，心里只有恐惧和不安，希望这股火焰在我死前都不要烧到我身上。」

paragraphs.en: Regarding other titles and what motivates him to create games, Taro said “I don’t really get jealous of other games. When I come across something good, I end up viewing it from a fan’s perspective. This triggers my collector trait, and I just want to buy them all.”
paragraphs.cn: 谈到其他作品以及自己创作游戏的动力时，横尾太郎说：「我其实不怎么嫉妒其他游戏。遇到好作品时，我最终都会从粉丝的角度去看待它们。这会勾起我的收藏欲，让我想把它们全买下来。」

paragraphs.en: “I’ve always worked in the games industry with the mindset of ‘filling in the gaps,’ he explained. “For example, I really like games like ICO and (Treasure’s bullet hell shooter) Ikaruga, but when I played them they were so perfect that I thought, ‘I don’t need to make games in these genres.’ That’s not jealousy, it’s the feeling of, ‘This gap has already been filled, so I need to fill a different one.’ I think the reason that my games are crude games full of terrible things is because the pioneers have already seized all the beautiful aspects.”
paragraphs.cn: 他解释道：「我一直抱着填补空白的心态在游戏行业工作。比如，我非常喜欢《ICO》和《斑鸠》（Treasure开发的弹幕射击游戏）这样的作品，但玩过之后，我觉得它们太完美了，自己已经没必要再做这些类型的游戏了。这不是嫉妒，而是觉得这个空白已经有人填补了，我得去填补别的空白。我想，我的游戏之所以粗糙、充满糟糕的东西，是因为美好的部分已经全被先行者占去了。」

paragraphs.en: Since 2021’s Nier Reincarnation and the reboot of Nier Replicant, Taro has worked on the Voice of Cards RPG series and 2024 mobile title 404 GAME RE:SET. He is currently writing the upcoming as-yet untitled Neon Genesis Evangelion TV series , with NieR and Drakengard composer Keiichi Okabe providing the music.
paragraphs.cn: 继2021年的《尼尔：转生》和《尼尔：人工生命》重启版之后，横尾太郎参与了《Voice of Cards》RPG系列以及2024年手游《404 GAME RE:SET》的开发。他目前正在为一部尚未定名的《新世纪福音战士》电视动画新作撰写剧本，音乐则由《尼尔》和《龙背上的骑兵》系列作曲家冈部启一负责。

paragraphs.en: Of course, Nier fans are desperate for a proper follow-up, but so far nothing has been announced. In November last year, the developer said he’d been working on various projects, but they just keep getting canceled .
paragraphs.cn: 当然，《尼尔》粉丝都迫切盼望一部真正的续作，但目前还没有任何相关消息公布。去年11月，横尾太郎曾表示，他一直在忙各种项目，但这些项目总是接连被取消。

paragraphs.en: “I often get told stuff like, ‘Why aren’t you making a new sequel to NieR?’ or, ‘Yoko Taro isn’t doing anything,’ but that’s because recently, a lot of projects I was involved in got discontinued midway through development," he said.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我经常听到有人说，像是「为什么不做《尼尔》的新续作？」或者「横尾太郎什么都没在做」。但这是因为最近我参与的很多项目都在开发中途被取消了。」

paragraphs.en: "I’ve actually been working on some stuff, it’s just that it never ended up seeing the light of day. I got paid for it, so I personally have no issues with that, but people seem to think that I haven’t been doing anything just because none of the work I’ve done is being released."
paragraphs.cn: 「其实我一直在做些东西，只是这些作品最终都没能问世。我拿到了报酬，所以我个人对此没什么意见。但就因为我做的作品都没有推出，大家似乎就觉得我什么都没做。」

paragraphs.en: Verity Townsend is a Japan-based freelance writer who previously served as editor, contributor and translator for the game news site Automaton West. She has also written about Japanese culture and movies for various publications.
paragraphs.cn: Verity Townsend是一位常驻日本的自由撰稿人，此前曾在游戏新闻网站Automaton West担任编辑、撰稿人和译者。她还为多家刊物撰写过有关日本文化和电影的文章。
